sample_unit: clinical rule sets and state machines with safety properties
unlisted_practices: Formal verification (SMT) of safety constraints for agentic clinical AI, giving proofs over the whole input space or replayable counterexamples
Testing safety properties across successive encounters (longitudinal, cross-encounter) and across medical and social care domains
Using language-model judges to check clinical safety properties

screen.practice: formal SMT verification of safety constraints versus unit testing, LLM judges, and physician review
screen.reason: The study introduces a benchmark (CIV-Bench) to evaluate and compare different guardrail/safety verification approaches (SMT formal verification vs LLM judges, unit testing, and physician panels) for agentic clinical AI systems.

primary.practice: formally verified safety constraints and guardrails
